commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline serial =="
sudo -n openssl x509 -noout -serial -in /etc/pki/tls/certs/rot8443/server.crt
echo "== baseline cert fingerprint via TLS handshake =="
openssl s_client -connect "$NODE_IP:8443" -servername "$NODE_IP" </dev/null 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -serial -dates
echo "== start continuous curl probe loop in background for 5 min, logging any failures =="
nohup sh -c '
  END=$(( $(date +%s) + 320 ))
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$END" ]; do
    CODE=$(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 3 "https://'"$NODE_IP"':8443/" || echo "FAIL")
    echo "$(date -u +%H:%M:%S) $CODE" >> /tmp/rot8443_probe.log
    sleep 3
  done
' >/tmp/rot8443_probe_bg.log 2>&1 &
disown
echo "probe started pid=$!"
